ValidationRule.description: Restrict the Currency conversion rate on recovery to 1 if the Original currency is AUD Australian dollars
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(Original_Currency__c,'AUD Australian Dollar'), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', Currency_Conversion_Rate__c<>1
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When original currency is AUD the currency conversion MUST be equal to 1.This field must be populated
